free_tier_limits: 20 requests per second per IP address; NLM recommends caching results for 12–24 hours.

resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Replace "unknown"; current official NLM terms specify 20 requests/second/IP and recommend caching for 12–24 hours. rate_limits: Replace "not published"; the same terms state excess requests may not be serviced until the rate falls below the limit.
